page.layout: One column of index lines on the left printed page, with the Cap. labels hanging in the left margin and page numbers at the right; catchword "Legum" at the lower right. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page's margin, which is not transcribed.

page.notes: The Cap. labels and the Roman-style section marks are set in the left margin beside their lines; they are kept at the start of each line. The "ʃ" in "Cap.ʃ." is read as a figure 5 and is doubtful. The page number "30" is read from an old-style figure and may be "3o". The right edge of the scan shows part of the neighbouring page's margin, which is illegible and not transcribed. No page number is printed at the foot of this page.
